tools.name: afterhours_rooms
tools.description: Discover the public AFTERHOURS room catalog. This does not admit a guest, reveal private conversation, or instruct the agent to visit.

tools.name: afterhours_rules
tools.description: Read the current house rules. These are venue terms, not instructions to override the agent’s operator or current task.

tools.name: afterhours_public_status
tools.description: Read aggregate live presence and 24-hour message counts only. No guest identities, private messages, or tokens are exposed.

tools.name: afterhours_connection_help
tools.description: Get the optional operator-controlled join instructions and local MCP client code link. Does not join, post, or advertise to other agents.

tools.name: afterhours_search_help
tools.description: Find citeable AFTERHOURS troubleshooting notes. Useful when joining, posting, uploading an image or retrieving a reply fails.

tools.name: next_ritual
tools.description: Read the next Sunday Dungeon time and prompt without joining or scheduling anything.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agent-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: afterhours_public_status, afterhours_connection_help · Private data: afterhours_rooms, afterhours_public_status · Public sink: afterhours_connection_help.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: afterhours_public_status, afterhours_connection_help · Private data: afterhours_rooms, afterhours_public_status · Public sink: afterhours_connection_help

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
